title: AI catalog index
description: Generated, committed index of everything the catalog offers (catalog/index.json). Written by 'catalog.py index'; never hand-edited. Entries are sorted by (id, kind) so the file diffs cleanly.

indexVersion.description: Index format version. Only 1 is produced or understood in Phase 0.

generatedBy.description: Command that regenerates this file, recorded for humans reading a diff.

items.description: Every available item, sorted by id then kind.

shadowed.description: Items skipped because an earlier source already offers the same name for that kind. Reported, never dropped silently.

by.description: The id that kept the name.

path.description: The install path they both wanted.

id.description: Namespaced selection id, always 'source:name' (the template source is written bare in the manifest but fully here).

source.description: Source id this item comes from; Phase 0 has only 'template'.

kind.description: Item kind. ids are unique per kind, not across kinds.

name.description: Item name: the skill directory name or the agent file stem.

path.description: Path of the item relative to the source root, POSIX separators (e.g. '.ai/skills/council').

sourcePath.description: Path of the item inside its resolved source (e.g. 'skills/council' upstream, '.ai/skills/council' for the template). `path` is the installed location; the two differ for an external catalog.

description.description: Short description taken from the YAML frontmatter; empty when the frontmatter has none.

category.description: Category id from catalog/categories.json. Declared in the item's frontmatter, or resolved from the source's keyword rules for sources that declare nothing. 'uncategorised' is the visible fallback.

tags.description: Extra cross-cutting tags from the item's frontmatter. A tag that names a category is promoted to the category, so `mobile` + `tags: testing` lands under Mobile and stays findable by 'testing'.

ref.description: Source revision this entry was indexed at, copied from the manifest's sources.template.ref.

sha256.description: Item hash: sha256 over the sorted '<relpath>\u0000<content-sha256>' lines of every file in the item, excluding markers and __pycache__.

files.description: Number of files the item hash covers.

license.description: License of the source content (MIT for the template source).

requires.description: Ids this item depends on: an agent's declared `skills:` frontmatter, or a skill's `requires:`. Always in the same source. A reference the catalog cannot satisfy is left here verbatim and only becomes fatal when the item is selected.
